anita-partnerships: Quick sync — we need an oncall runbook for partner trace escalations (Datadog + OpenTelemetry) ahead of Wed APAC demo. Main concerns: air-gapped customer, restricted egress, and SI handoff.
ton y-eng: Ack. Do we want a single runbook or per-customer? I'd prefer template + fillable steps.
sam-obs: +1 template. I can draft steps for trace ingestion failures, exporter misconfig, sampling skew, and dashboard missing spans.
kai-sre: include runbook snippet for emergency fallback -> switch to local agent + file sink, and contact SI. Also include escalation matrix.
anita-partnerships: Great. Outline: 1) Triage (check agent status, exporter logs), 2) Quick fixes (restart agent, verify OTLP endpoint certs), 3) Fallback, 4) Contact points, 5) Postmortem.
sam-obs: I'll add commands:
```
# check collector
systemctl status otel-collector
# tail logs
journalctl -u otel-collector -f
# curl test
curl -v --cert /etc/ssl/cert.pem https://otel-endpoint.example/api/v1/traces
```
tony-eng: Add note about Datadog API keys rotation and encoding; often causes 403s. Also include example header: `DD-API-KEY: <redacted>` and mention base64 pitfalls.
kai-sre: For air-gapped: include step to validate checksum of offline bundle + instructions to manually upload via USB/secure import. I'll paste link to internal doc: https://redwood.internal/airgap-tracing
anita-partnerships: Can we get this ready by EOD tomorrow? Sam + Kai to own drafts, Tony to review ops commands, I'll coordinate SI contact list.
deploy-bot: Reminder: Demo env deploy scheduled Wed 04:00 UTC — smoke tests run at 03:30 UTC :rocket:
sam-obs: ack, will drop draft in /docs/partner-runbooks/ by EOD. Ping me for review.
anita-partnerships: Thanks — tagging @tony-eng @kai-sre for visibility :handshake:
